name: CapCut
author: Bytedance Pte. Ltd.
summary: A video editing tool packed with features on your desktop or laptop
description: CapCut is an all-in-one online video editing software which makes creation, upload & share easier, with frame by frame track editor, cloud drive etc.

- Support saving frequently used transitions, filters, animations, and text effects to Favorites.
- Added quick brush to AI Removal feature and AI Replace feature.
- Fixed some known issues for improved editing experience.

- Added caption templates for diverse caption effects.
- Support video AI removal: Simply brush to select and remove with one click.
- Fixed some known issues for improved editing experience.

- Added custom tracking for any area to camera tracking.
- Added new scenes to auto removal for improved portrait removal.
- Short text recommendations are now supported in AI writer for smart generation of narrations, editing, expanding, and summarizing.
- Layout presets and custom layouts are now supported in the editor window for improved editing efficiency.
- AI image inpaint is now supported with smart erase or content replacement.

- Optical flow is now supported in videos for improved smoothness.
- Compound clips can now be saved as presets for improved creation efficiency in one click.
- Timeline track height and audio waveform size adjustment supported for more convenient editing.
- Fixed some known experience issues for smoother editing.

- Several preinstalled, realistic, AI-generated people with natural backgrounds have been added.
- Smart Split in the editor now supports deleting and moving split points.
- Clean up edge and Feather edge added to Chroma keying.
- Fixed some known issues - improved the editing experience.

We’ve introduced and upgraded some features to help you make even more amazing videos
1. You can now access projects from desktop and mobile on CapCut Cloud Space.
2. Italian, French, Turkish, Chinese, Dutch, Vietnamese, Thai, Malay, and Romanian are now supported in auto captions.
3. “Split scene” is availble now. Right click to try it out. You can split scene of the videos on the video tracks and material panel to make your re-creation more efficient.
4. You can now undo importing material and deleting materials in Local.
5. You can now use commercial music for TikTok commercial use.
6. Fixed the issue of video flash after clip splitting.
7. Fixed the issue of duration change after adding transitions.

We’ve introduced and upgraded some features to help you make even more amazing videos
1. New feature of color wheel is available now.
2. New features of removing video flickers and video noise reduction are available now.
3. New feature of customized cutout is available now.
4. More retouch options are available now.
5. New feature of caption exporting is available now.
6. New feature of audio channels setting is available now.

We’ve introduced and upgraded some features to help you make even more amazing videos
1. Local music now supports auto beat.
2. You can now customize the shortcuts.

2. New feature of glow text is now supported.
3. You can now customize the shortcuts.

2. You can now preview materials by scrolling the mouse wheel
